## Checklist

- [ ] Tests were written first (RED) and pass now (GREEN)
- [ ] Coverage is at least 80% for changed code; 100% for triage/loss-matrix calculations
- [ ] No hardcoded secrets, keys, tokens, or credentials
- [ ] Commit messages follow the conventional format
- [ ] Documentation updated, or no documentation impact
- [ ] No unrelated changes included
